typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features clear serifs (small strokes at the ends of the main strokes) and a moderate contrast between thick and thin lines. The proportions and structure are characteristic of early 20th-century printing presses, leaning towards a classic Roman style used for academic and formal publications.
